layouts.name: Shelsley Walsh Hillclimb
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The course follows the named, one-way raceway from existing start-area node 2537296479 through Kennel bend and the upper Esses. The previous selection incorrectly travelled east on service way 1066055853 and returned west on a nearly coincident raceway, adding 77.7 m of duplicated approach. The geolocated start photograph (Geograph 8009693, looking west) and pinned raceway direction support removing that out-and-back; no coordinates are fitted to a target length. The corrected source route measures 939.4 m. The operator specifies a 1,000-yard (914.4 m) timed course, whereas the legacy catalogue scalar is 1163 m. The sparse final raceway segment ends 38.5 m beyond the supplied finish along the same road, with under 2 m perpendicular displacement. The existing 40 m endpoint allowance is retained; the source extent remains provisional and is not an exact timed-run distance. No interpolated finish vertex is added. All retained coordinates are exact pinned OpenStreetMap nodes. Boundaries and timing extent require review.
